message.content:
LeBron James is an American professional basketball player widely regarded as one of the greatest players in NBA history. He was born on December 30, 1984, in Akron, Ohio, and played high school basketball at St. Vincent‑St. Mary High School, where he gained national attention as a prodigy. After being selected first overall in the 2003 NBA Draft by the Cleveland Cavaliers, LeBron quickly became a dominant force in the league.

He has won multiple NBA championships (2012, 2013 with the Miami Heat; 2016, 2020 with the Los Angeles Lakers) and earned numerous MVP awards. Known for his versatility—capable of playing point guard, shooting guard, small forward, power forward, and center—he combines exceptional athleticism, court vision, passing ability, and scoring prowess. Off the court, LeBron is also known for his philanthropy, notably opening the “I Promise” school in Akron, and for his involvement in media ventures such as producing films and television shows.
